explication: Spring AI is a Spring-oriented framework for connecting application data and APIs to AI models. A typical user workflow passes a request through ChatClient, optionally applies advisor and RAG patterns using vector stores and conversation memory, calls a model, and returns a response; tool calling lets the model request application-side actions. Other major capabilities include document ingestion, structured output, observability, and MCP client/server integrations. The README documents these capabilities, but sampled source is limited, so links between unsampled subsystems are documented capability-level relationships rather than claims about internal call paths.
